title: Open spectra fell from 34% to 21% of datasets as COMPLETE submissions halved; mzML still rose
sub:
PRIDE datasets 2013–2025 (n = 36,249) with at least one top-level file of each type (file names; compression stripped; /generated/ paths
and zip contents excluded). Periods: 2013–16 (n = 2,726) vs 2023–25 (n = 15,565). Standard results = corrected mzIdentML/mzTab definition.
b–c, open spectra by PRIDE submission type (COMPLETE submissions must include peak lists). COMPLETE fell from 29% to 15% of datasets,
accounting for 5–10 of the 13-point fall (shift-share, both orders). Shading: 95% CI, group bootstrap. Presence ≠ validity or reuse.
